meta.title: VoxNexus — Hand work over, by voice | Agentware Studio
meta.description: VoxNexus is a voice AI agent platform: describe an agent in a sentence and it is built; the agent then talks and gets the work done. Connected to your business systems, it looks things up, takes requests and hands calls over.

name: VoxNexus
summary: A voice AI agent platform: you create agents by talking, and the agents get work done by talking.
features: Natural conversation with instant barge-in, in several languages
Lookups, intake, bookings and updates in the business systems you connect
Connects to existing systems through MCP and APIs; external tools can be added
Hand-over between agents and to people, with the whole conversation
The Admin Agent creates and configures Voice Agents
The Admin Agent investigates problems and explains how to use the platform
Every operation is allowed, confirmed with the customer or refused; people approve important changes; everything is recorded

hero.title:
Hand work over,
by voice.
hero.lead: Create AI agents by talking. They talk, and get the work done.

shift.now: From now: it hears what you need and sees it through.

items.title: Stock and delivery dates
items.body: When a customer calls, it checks the production system and answers on the spot, nights and weekends included.

items.title: Repair intake and hand-over
items.body: “The machine has stopped.” It takes down the symptom and machine number, opens a ticket and passes the whole conversation to the person in charge.

items.title: Bulk notices
items.body: Delivery changes and inspection bookings go out as calls, within the hours and redial rules you set.

items.title: Questions in Teams meetings
items.body: It joins the meeting and answers questions about stock and progress as they come up.

items.title: Orders and bookings
items.body: From identity checks to lookups and change requests. Before it changes anything, it confirms with the customer.

items.title: Account details
items.body: It looks up what is on record and answers. Operations it is not allowed to perform, it refuses plainly.

items.title: Hand-over to staff
items.body: What it has learned is passed along as is, so customers never explain the same thing twice.

items.title: Internal help desk
items.body: Questions about procedures and rules, answered from the company’s own documents.

items.title: Across languages
items.body: It speaks English or Chinese with staff from abroad, switching to the caller’s language.

items.title: Requests
items.body: Leave and equipment requests are taken by voice and entered into the business system.

trust.title: What it may not do, it refuses plainly.
items: Performs only the operations it is allowed
Every operation is recorded, and earlier settings can be restored
Runs on your own servers; call records stay inside the company

items.q: How is this different from an ordinary phone menu?
items.a: A phone menu answers along fixed menus and scripts. A VoxNexus Voice Agent understands what the caller needs, carries out lookups, intake and updates in the business systems you connect, and hands the call over when needed.

items.q: Can it connect to the production system we already have?
items.a: Yes, through MCP and APIs. For each connected operation you decide whether it is allowed, confirmed with the customer first, or refused.
It handles Japanese, English, Chinese and more, switching to the caller’s language.

items.q: Can we use it without specialist knowledge?
items.a: Tell the Admin Agent what you need and it drafts the Voice Agent’s configuration. It also answers how-to questions and fills in the page for you.

items.q: What if the caller wants a person?
items.a: It hands the call to a human operator, together with the conversation so far.
Yes. It answers questions during the meeting.
On your own servers, with call records kept inside the company.
